rationale: Kaede brings hands-on expertise in IoT and embedded systems from Seeed Studio, while AJ is building dexterous robotic systems that require tight hardware-software integration. AJ's focus on practical robot manipulation and hardware co-design aligns with the embedded systems foundation Kaede helps developers implement, making them natural collaborators on the physical systems side of robotics.
intro_message: Kaede Lin, meet AJ Chahal — you're both deep in hardware-software integration for physical systems, and AJ's robotics work could benefit from Kaede's embedded and IoT expertise at scale.
